title: Ackermann Kinematic Model
text: Car-like vehicle motion using Ackermann kinematic model, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Wheel base} sets the distance between front and rear axles, {Vehicle speed range} sets the minimum and maximum vehicle speeds, {Maximum steering angle}, {Initial state} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: stateDot
ports.summary: Derivatives of state output four-element vector

params.name: Wheel base
params.values: Distance between front and rear axles 1 (default) | positive numeric scalar

params.name: Vehicle speed range
params.values: Minimum and maximum vehicle speeds [-Inf Inf] (default) | two-element vector

params.name: Maximum steering angle
params.values: Maximum steering angle pi/4 (default) | positive numeric scalar

params.name: Initial state
params.values: Initial state of vehicle [0;0;0;0] (default) | four-element vector

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
